name: @cognovamx/pdf-inspector
description: MX Compatible PDF inspector CLI — walks a PDF or directory, classifies each file as MX Compatible / EAA Tagged Only / Plain, emits markdown or JSON, exits non-zero when anything is below the configured minimum tier. The standalone distribution of the same detect-classify pipeline that runs the public inspector at https://mx.allabout.network/tools/pdf-inspector.html.
author: Tom Cranstoun (CogNovaMX, trading name of Digital Domain Technologies Ltd)
